summary: Man in his 20s fell ~40 ft while climbing at Duncan's Ridge near Horsetooth Reservoir (~4:55 p.m. report Tuesday); Poudre Fire Authority crew hiked in and used a high-angle rope system and rescue basket; UCHealth Life Line air ambulance located him and transported him to a hospital with significant injuries
location: Duncan's Ridge, east side of Horsetooth Reservoir, west of Fort Collins
responding_agency: Poudre Fire Authority; UCHealth Life Line
notes: Rocky Mountain Collegian 2017-09-14, incident date stated as Sept. 12; victim identity withheld
